title: Mercenaries 2 spawn table (entity name → Blueprint)
description: DataTable schema for overlay-driven spawning. Entity names come from placement records and rainbow_table.json resolution of type_hash / entity_id. Spawner placements currently skipped in populate_world.py; this table drives a future SpawnManager subsystem.

EntityNamePattern.description: Exact entity name or glob (case-insensitive match against placement entity_name)

EntityNameHash.description: Optional pandemic_hash_m2(entity_name) when name is canonical

BlueprintPath.description: Soft object path to UE5 actor Blueprint, e.g. /Game/Mercs2/Characters/BP_VZSoldier

OverlayLayer.description: vz_state layer stem that owns this spawn (Data Layer name)

bSpawnOnAccept.description: If true, spawn when mission Accepted() fires (second streaming phase)

SpawnerApi.description: Vanilla Lua API used to toggle this spawner group (from lua_call_sites_from_scripts.md)

lookup_order: Exact EntityNamePattern match on placement entity_name
Fallback: skip with warning (current populate_world behavior)
runtime_flow: MissionSubsystem activates vz_state Data Layer from FMissionData.tLayers
SpawnManager reads DT_SpawnRegistry rows where OverlayLayer matches
For each placement in active layer with matching entity_name, spawn BlueprintPath at game_to_ue transform
On layer deactivate or mission cleanup, despawn tracked actors
